explanation: A sorried API lemma asserting that cardSet d n is nonempty, so that f d n is its least element. This is true. For d ≥ 1, existence follows from the bound f_d(n) ≤ n^{O_d(1)} noted on erdosproblems.com/1088, or from Ramsey-type arguments. For d = 0 every m ≥ max(n, 2) qualifies vacuously, because ℝ^0 has a single point.
